continuity: Jin Taekyung has recovered completely through five System level-ups, though his mind remains exhausted from the repeated battles.
Jeok Cheongang is confirmed to be the Blood Monk and had disguised himself as a monk to evade Dark Heaven while fighting the unorthodox faction in Guangxi.
Jeok Cheongang reached the battlefield after learning that Jin Taekyung was in danger and has reunited with his surviving Disciple.
Only about thirty people remain alive at the battlefield from the nearly one thousand Nanman warriors and three hundred Baekcheon Unit members.
Wang Ho survives his severe injuries after Jin Taekyung sends internal energy through him.
The Beast Miao King remains unconscious with numerous sword fragments embedded in his body and severe internal injuries, but Jeok Cheongang believes he can survive treatment.
The White Tiger remains gravely wounded but conscious and has revealed that it intends to use the sacred stone to close the rift.
The guardian spirit saved Jin Taekyung and entrusted him with the sacred stone partly because he reminds it of the first Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace.
plot: Jin Taekyung awakens perfectly healed after five System level-ups, exposing the System to Jeok Cheongang, who reveals that he is the Blood Monk and had disguised himself as a monk while destroying six unorthodox faction organizations in Guangxi. Jeok explains that he rushed to Jin's aid after hearing from Jin's allies, and the two reconcile before beginning to treat the battlefield's survivors. Jin's Qi Sense detects only about thirty living people from the nearly one thousand Nanman warriors and three hundred Baekcheon Unit members. Jin stabilizes Wang Ho, while Jeok judges that the gravely injured Beast Miao King can probably survive but is uncertain about the wounded White Tiger. The guardian spirit reveals that it saved Jin and entrusted him with the sacred stone because he reminded it of the first Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, then indicates that it intends to use the sacred stone to close the rift.
translation_decisions: Retain Blood Monk, Old Master, Qi Sense, Will, sacred stone, and rift as established renderings.
Render Jeok Cheongang's 노부 as this old man or I according to context, preserving his gruff and profane voice.
Render the guardian spirit's 의념 as Will and preserve its terse, telepathic, contemptuous voice.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung has fully recovered through five System level-ups, but remains mentally exhausted after the battlefield.
Jeok Cheongang is confirmed as the Blood Monk and has reunited with Jin Taekyung after fighting through Guangxi to reach him.
The battlefield has only about thirty survivors from the Nanman warriors and Baekcheon Unit.
Wang Ho survived after Jin treated his severe injuries.
The Beast Miao King is unconscious and gravely injured, though Jeok believes he can survive treatment.
The White Tiger is gravely wounded but conscious and intends to use the sacred stone to close the rift.
The guardian spirit saved Jin and entrusted him with the sacred stone because he resembles the first Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace.
open_questions: What is the Southern Heaven Demon Empress's final status after Jin's throat attack and Jeok's Flame Divine Palm?
Will the Beast Miao King survive treatment?
Will the White Tiger survive long enough to close the rift?
What will happen to the sacred stone when the guardian spirit attempts to close the rift?
What caused the bell and warmth accompanying Jin's recovery beyond the five level-ups?
temporary_decisions: Retain Blood Monk as Jeok Cheongang's revealed sobriquet.
Retain Old Master for Jin Taekyung's address to Jeok Cheongang.
Render the guardian spirit's 의념 as Will.
Preserve Jeok Cheongang's gruff, profane dialogue and Jin Taekyung's dry first-person voice.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** The Beast Miao King is the Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, a Supreme Peak master among the Ten Kings, and Great Chieftain of the Miao people; after shielding Jin Taekyung from the Southern Heaven Demon Empress's explosion, he lies unconscious with sword fragments embedded throughout his body.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** The Beast Miao King is the Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, a Supreme Peak master among the Ten Kings, and Great Chieftain of the Miao people.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Unknown; the captured witness who described him was unable to provide further information before dying.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** As Jeok Cheongang, the Blood Monk is gruff, blunt, protective toward his Disciple, and prone to profane mockery.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** The Southern Heaven Demon Empress is Honglan, creator of the rift behind the Inner Palace; she survives the explosion that follows Baeksang's ambush, is critically wounded after Jin Taekyung drives White Flame through her chest, loses both arms, has her remaining innate qi stripped away, and is struck by Jeok Cheongang's Flame Divine Palm before Jin attacks her throat.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** The Southern Heaven Demon Empress is Honglan, the creator of the rift behind the Inner Palace.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Wang Ho is the Commander of the Baekcheon Unit; after Jin Taekyung returns to fight, he joins fewer than twenty surviving warriors in their assault on the Southern Heaven Demon Empress.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Wang Ho is the Commander of the Baekcheon Unit.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** The White Tiger is the guardian spirit of the sacred stone and leads the Sacred Land beasts; after shielding Jin Taekyung from the Southern Heaven Demon Empress's explosion, it lies gravely wounded while the sacred stone has shrunk to child-fist size.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** The White Tiger is the guardian spirit of the sacred stone and leader of the Sacred Land beasts; it intends to use the sacred stone to close the rift.
